title: Final release requirements, publication sequence and closure audit

baseline.head: 6784f8d3fc2af7814cdf9e7c328fa0eef2981b06
baseline.subject: Stage 9.4a: assemble and validate release candidate

github_evidence_limitation: Server-only facts require release-owner authenticated UI/API evidence at execution gates.

release_date_policy.declared_date: The release date deliberately declared by the release owner when preparing final release state.
release_date_policy.tagged_content: The exact Gate 1 approved/tagged commit contains the declared date.
release_date_policy.publication_operation: Publication proceeds as one controlled operation associated with the declared date.
release_date_policy.gate_2: Record the actual GitHub Release timestamp and verify the correct tag and exact approved commit.
release_date_policy.incidental_utc_rollover: Does not require a new commit or retagging during a continuous publication operation.
release_date_policy.deliberate_postponement: Stop, update the declared date and every affected output, repeat Gate 1, and obtain a new GO.
prohibitions: Do not backdate to match an earlier preparation date.
Do not silently move or replace a publicly accessible release tag.
